acceptanceCriteria: doctor reports ROLE-QUEUE-DEEP per role when the count of tickets whose work state matches the role exceeds its cap for N ticks, with depth, cap, oldest wait and whether global/pressure caps allow a raise.
Optional policy: a role may declare capMax and scale between cap and capMax while its queue is deep and pressure is calm, returning to cap when the queue drains; never above global or pressure caps.
Fixture tests for both acceptance cases; Closes #1183.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1183. A no-run review role capped at 2 had 10 tickets waiting, each also holding a scarce downstream run resource, while host pressure was calm; nothing surfaced it.
title: GH #1183: doctor ROLE-QUEUE-DEEP and optional role capMax scaling under calm pressure
